# Staffing — universal playbooks

12 playbooks. Universal: these edge cases occur in every vertical.

| ID | | Trigger | Automated handling | Expected output | What stays human |

| [`STA-01`](../../agents/playbooks/universal/staffing/sta-01-staff-calls-in-sick-morning-of.yaml) |  | Staff calls in sick morning-of | Day rebuilt: affected bookings identified, cover blast to qualified pool, customers re-slotted or notified, priority order by value | Rebuilt day: cover assigned; customers re-slotted and notified by priority | Which customers to bump if uncoverable |
| [`STA-02`](../../agents/playbooks/universal/staffing/sta-02-staff-quits-without-notice.yaml) |  | Staff quits without notice | Offboarding: access revoked everywhere, handover capture from their open jobs, customer reassignment, exit checklist | Access revoked; open work reassigned; exit checklist complete | Retention counter-offer |

| [`STA-05`](../../agents/playbooks/universal/staffing/sta-05-leave-request-conflict.yaml) |  | Leave request conflict | Collision detected against roster and other requests, options generated per policy and seniority rules | Conflict options per policy; decision logged | Tie-breaks |
